reading: With Mercury running both the Maha Dasha and the Antardasha and ruling your 1st and 10th houses, these years concentrate on how you present yourself and what you build in public work. In daily life this shows as fresh personal starts, how others read you, and career moves. Rahu's sub-period works in trine with Mercury, so the two cooperate, though its pull toward study, creative projects and risky money choices sits beside your Antardasha, now around its midpoint.
